purpose: What formportal's package schemas need so formfabric can host extension packs. Data only; the change is made in formai_dev's catalog/ first and copied into formportal by its owner.

proposed_package_kinds.for: fabric presets (.ffab), style files (.ffstyle), poses (.ffpose) and motions (.ffmotion) packed as a folder of files
Python plugins in the PARAMS model (a .py file with PARAMS and run), listed by the Plugins menu

notes: No new kind or permission value is requested: the four kinds above already exist in the schema enum. A script-plugin runs Python inside formfabric's service with the engine commands only; formportal should treat it like any other script-plugin and require a signature if it ever allows plugins that import modules outside the standard library. Native packages are not proposed.
